title: Audit fixtures retain pending work and select the reporter their parser expects
steps: Run the fake pending social request until its timeout fires.
Run the React 18 handover, suggestions and public Find fixtures with asynchronous act.
Run traced red-file isolation using the explicit spec reporter.
expect: Timeout rejects rather than being cancelled with the event loop empty.
React interactions settle and teardown clears its keepalive.
The tracer identifies and reruns only the failing fixture, preserving the full read measurement.
evidence: The serial whole-repository audit reproduced event-loop cancellations in four fixture files and reporter-dependent failure in the tracer test.
fence: Only test-owned handles and reporter arguments change; production scheduling, timeouts and gate strictness remain unchanged.

tests: timeout: the request is aborted after timeoutMs
wo-build on a buildable row: one create, one Build, through the template pick; the address forgets it
the suggestions open under the field: focus stays in it, the list is a listbox, not a dialog
public Find: nothing happens on its own, the search is the area alone, and Continue hands on at most 10
runTraced: a red test file is run again alone; green then is a whole measurement, red three times is refused
